name: Kajiwara Hina
source: One of the apartment's tenant and a second year student, the protagonist's classmate. A natural airhead, but also a bit stubborn, resulting in constantly being misunderstood. Somewhat shy, when in front of the protagonist she becomes very nervous. Despite everything she is actually a really nice girl. Her relationship with Natsuki is pretty good since they live under the same roof.
translation: 公寓住户之一，也是二年级学生和主人公的同班同学。她天生迷糊，却又有点固执，因此总被人误解。她有些害羞，在主人公面前会非常紧张。尽管如此，她其实是个很好的女孩。由于和夏希住在同一屋檐下，她们的关系相当不错。
